products.name: XL Brown Twisted Handle Carrier Bag
products.descriptionHtml:
The XL Brown Twisted Handle Carrier Bag (315×165×360 mm) is designed for businesses that need maximum strength, extra space, and professional presentation. Made from premium kraft paper with reinforced twisted handles and a sturdy block-bottom base, it provides excellent support for oversized items such as multiple meal containers, gift boxes, clothing, shoes, and heavier retail products.

Its natural brown finish offers a clean, professional look, making it ideal for brands focused on sustainability and style. Perfect for takeaways, bakeries, clothing stores, homeware shops, and general retail use. Supplied in a pack of 100.

products.name: XLarge Brown Grab-Deliver Bag – Takeaway Printed
products.descriptionHtml:
The XLarge Brown Grab-Deliver Bag – Takeaway Printed is a durable and spacious kraft paper bag designed for heavy and multiple takeaway items. Featuring a bold Takeaway Printed design, it offers both strength and eye-catching presentation, ideal for enhancing your brand’s professional look.

Made from high-quality brown kraft paper, this bag is perfect for restaurants, takeaways, cafés, and food delivery services that require reliable packaging for meal boxes, containers, and large food orders. Its strong handles and reinforced structure ensure safe and easy carrying, making it a must-have for efficient food delivery.
